Theorem
[Kernel estimates with Ricci lower bound] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0012 1. Theorem 2.1\group section-2

Let $M^n$ be a complete Riemannian manifold with $\partial M^n=\emptyset $, and $\operatorname {Ric}_M \ge (n-1)H$. Set $V_{r_0}=V_{r_0}(p)$. If $f \in \mathcal{F}^{\varphi ,A}_2$ and $A < \frac12 r(H,V)$, then the kernel $k_f(x_1,x_2)$ is continuous for $x_1 \neq x_2$ and satisfies (2.13), (2.14), where \begin{equation} \tag {2.16} \widetilde{\omega }(B_A(x_j)) \ge \frac{1}{\left(2V_{r+r_0}^{H}/V_{r_0}\right)-1}. \end{equation}
